name: get_export_queue
description: Read the native export queue. Each entry includes its identifier and exact marked range.

name: add_export_range
description: Add the current marked range to the native queue, preserving the captured edit and media.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

name: remove_export_range
description: Remove one entry from this project’s native export queue.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

name: render_project
description: Check or render an unsaved timeline snapshot using the native export planner. Read the job with live_job_status. A completed preflight can report eligible false with a structured issue. Ordinary copy preflight can offer verified boundaries and export alternatives.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

mode.description: Defaults to the native movie preference for full-track movies and copy for a single track type or audio-only sources.

quality.description: Use smaller, balanced or high for H.264 and HEVC. Use 422-lt, 422 or 422-hq for ProRes. Requires movie encode mode.

audioTrackOrdinal.description: Zero-based track within the ordinary source audio tracks.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to write output.

useReviewedCuts.description: Use the native verified copy-boundary proposal for this ordinary export only. The timeline and its history stay intact.

name: apply_export_review
description: Recompute the native ordinary timeline lossless-copy boundary proposal for this output extension and apply it as one undoable edit. Use render_project with dryRun first.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

name: export_queue
description: Check or export queued snapshots to an existing directory. Poll live_job_status for completed outputs, including files already written if a later range fails or is cancelled.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

audioTrackOrdinal.description: Zero-based track within the ordinary source audio tracks.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to write output.

name: export_review_frames
description: Export a full-resolution still at the playhead, or a manifest and JPEGs to a new directory. Explicit times use source time on the active ordinary clip and group time on multicam. Playhead, explicit times and switches on multicam sample all angles. Poll live_job_status for the count of written frames and unavailable angle samples.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

limit.description: Optional maximum frame count for scene or non-silent sampling.

name: convert_live_project
description: Export the current unsaved edit as a new .cut, .drp, .drt, .prproj, .fcpxml, .fcpxmld or .fcpbundle. Host applications may be required. Poll live_job_status for warnings and actual output paths.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

name: send_live_to_resolve
description: Write the live edit as Resolve-compatible FCPXML and optionally import the new timeline into the current Resolve project. The job records the XML and any linked audio directory separately from host import success.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

name: replace_live_audio
description: Replace the ordinary clip source soundtrack using a new working copy and native history. Supply clip, replacement and output. For multicam choose an existing source/stream or an external replacement recording to set the program soundtrack.

operationID.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

name: live_job_status
description: Read progress, terminal outcome and published paths for an export job in this project.

name: cancel_live_job
description: Request cancellation of this project’s specific output job; inspect its terminal result to see which outputs were published.
